Name: Sennacherib, King of Assyria
Summary: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, took Judah's fenced cities, demanded Hezekiah's surrender, mocked the living God through the Rabshakeh, and lost a hundred and fourscore and five thousand men in one night to the angel of the LORD.
KeyStory: Sennacherib mocks God and loses his army in a night.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 18:13; 2 Kings 19:35; 2 Chronicles 32:1; 2 Chronicles 32:9; 2 Chronicles 32:21; Isaiah 36:1; Isaiah 37:21-29; Isaiah 37:36-38
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Isaiah; Eliakim, Son of Hilkiah; Adrammelech, Son of Sennacherib; Sharezer, Son of Sennacherib; Adrammelech; Sharezer
LifeLesson: Mocking the living God is the last boast an empire makes before morning.
